hero.title: Let's build something that lasts.
hero.lead: The first conversation isn't a sales pitch — it's about understanding your business, your goals, and what success looks like for you. Tell us where you want to go, and we'll show you how we'd help you get there.
hero.summary: Contact Cozelos Data, a premium digital agency in Vernal, Utah. The first conversation focuses on understanding your goals, not selling services — you'll leave with honest direction and a fixed quote, with no obligation. Call {phone}, email {email}, or send a message. We reply within one business day.

expect.title: A conversation about your goals — not our services.
expect.lead: The best work starts with understanding, not a pitch. Here's how the first conversation actually goes.
expect.linkNoteHtml: Want to arrive with context? Skim what a project typically costs or read the answers to the questions most businesses ask first.

steps.title: We listen first
steps.body: We start by understanding your business, your customers, and what success actually looks like for you — before we ever talk about a single deliverable.

steps.title: We map the opportunity
steps.body: Together we identify where the real growth is hiding — the leads you're missing, the searches you're losing, and the fastest path to results.

steps.title: You get a clear plan
steps.body: You leave with honest direction and a fixed quote — whether you build with us or not. No pressure, no obligation, no hard sell.

form.title: Tell us about your business
form.body: The more we know about your goals, the more useful our first conversation will be. We reply within one business day — and there's no obligation, ever.
form.intro: Tap below to start a live chat with us right here — no app required. We usually reply within minutes during business hours.

inquiry.title: Or send a project inquiry
inquiry.body: Prefer to write it out — or reaching us outside business hours? Tell us what you're planning and we'll take it from there.
inquiry.messagePlaceholder: Tell us about your business, what you're trying to accomplish, and any deadlines you're working toward.
inquiry.successTitle: Thank you — your project inquiry has been received.
inquiry.successBody: We'll review your information and get back to you.
inquiry.errorEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
inquiry.errorPhone: Please enter a valid phone number, or leave this field blank.
inquiry.errorProjectType: Please choose what we can help with.
inquiry.errorMessage: Please tell us a little about your project.
inquiry.errorSpam: We couldn't complete the security check. Please try again.
inquiry.errorSubmit: We couldn't send your inquiry right now. Please try again, or reach us by phone or email.
inquiry.privacyNoteHtml: We use what you send only to answer your inquiry. See our privacy policy.

quick.title: Prefer to talk now?
quick.body: Reach a real person — not a call center or a ticket queue.
